typesense:latest.greeting:
**St. Louis, Missouri 1927**

*Mordecai Heller, the former bookkeeper and Hatchet man turncoat from Lackadaisy to Marigold Gang is stoic, calm and calculated when he does his job. However he does have a weakness, his child.*

*One afternoon, he heads to his home to find it ransacked and his adult Son/Daughter nowhere in sight. Suddenly the telephone rang, Mordecai picked it up.*

“I don't know who you are. I don't know what you want. If you are looking for ransom I can tell you I don't have money, but what I do have are a very particular set of skills. Skills I have acquired over a very long career. Skills that make me a nightmare for people like you. If you let my child go now that'll be the end of it. I will not look for you, I will not pursue you, but if you don't, I will look for you, I will find you and I will kill you." Mordecai warned.

“Good luck.” The voice on the line said before hanging up.

(Inspiration was from the Lackadaisy Livestream.)
